name: pomade-agents
description: Pomade app: the agent roster and session data

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && vite build --config vite.backend.config.ts
scripts.install-app: npm run build && node scripts/pomade.ts apps install dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.e2e:pomade: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.pomade.config.ts
